newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares mixed but turnover stays high.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares mixed but turnover stays high.

text.p: Trade on the Estonian stock exchange on Monday was quiet compared to last week with high volumes and little price movement, dealers said.
Total volume on the official list was 51.8 million kroons and the Tallinn stock exchange index gained slightly with a 0.18 percent increase to 233.28.
"The volume was quite high compared to price movements, but Uhispank was very active with strong local interest speculating on small price changes," one dealer said.
Uhispank was the most active stock, firming slightly by 0.10 kroons to close at 47.85 kroons on turnover of 16.9 million kroons.
"Uhispank saw a lot of block trades from local investors with the price changing 0.10 kroons between buys and sells," another dealer said.
Hansapank turned over 9.5 million kroons of shares to ease 0.50 kroons to finish on 236.00 kroons.
"Hansapank reached a high of 240 kroons to fall back later in the day," another dealer said.
Pennu computer technology company was actively traded with 8.0 million kroons of shares changing hands, but slipped one kroon to finish the day on 118.00 kroons.
Hoiupank inched upwards to close on 117.50 kroons, a gain of 0.25 kroons on a turnover of 7.1 million kroons.
Forekspank saw a trade of 4.6 million kroons to close a little higher on 163.90, up 0.40 kroons.
Tallinna Pank was stable on 67.00 kroons after a light trade of three million kroons.
On the free market, trade was slow with only four million kroons of shares.
Diversified industrialist Norma was the most active with two million kroons of shares traded to close 0.80 kroons higher at 65.90 kroons.
